shortDescription.text: Multi-job build and deploy workflow lacks artifact handoff.

help.text: Publish immutable build outputs with actions/upload-artifact or push signed container images before deploying.

shortDescription.text: Third-party GitHub Action is not pinned to a 40-character commit SHA.

help.text: Pin third-party actions to a full 40-character commit SHA (for example, uses: owner/action@<40-hex-sha> # v1.2.3).

shortDescription.text: Workflow run block interpolates untrusted event context or writes to GITHUB_ENV/PATH.

help.text: Pass untrusted GitHub context values through intermediate step 'env:' variables, quote shell expansions, and avoid writing untrusted data to $GITHUB_ENV or $GITHUB_PATH.

shortDescription.text: Workflow grants write-all or omits least-privilege permissions.

help.text: Declare explicit least-privilege 'permissions:' (for example, contents: read) at the workflow or job level.

help.text: Configure short-lived OIDC federation with 'permissions: id-token: write' and replace long-lived static cloud keys.
